Replacement checks the opened file for outside changes and retains an independently verified recovery copy. Confirm that you are outside every match when saving; a running StarCraft II process alone does not prevent replacement.

BUILT FOR THE COMMUNITY

Our own map profiles and codecs. No generic bank generator and no unverified map imports.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Files are processed in your browser. Account handles stay on this device. A local flag prevents repeat counts. Only an aggregate visit counter is sent externally; its provider receives ordinary network metadata. No bank files or account details are sent.

KNOW YOUR VERSION

Offline validation is not a guarantee of acceptance by an updated map. Map-side account restrictions still apply.
